card.title: CHERBOURG
card.text: Cherbourg was an important harbor for the Allies after D-Day.
card.flavorText: Cherbourg was an important harbor for the Allies after D-Day. The Battle of Cherbourg was part of the Battle of Normandy during World War II. It was fought immediately after the successful Allied landings on June 6, 1944. Allied troops, predominantly American, isolated and captured the fortified port, which was considered vital to the campaign in Western Europe, in a hard-fought, month-long campaign.
